requests.prompt:
Create a production transparent full-body sprite sheet for Echoes of Dante, Organic Sci-Fi R3 painterly 2D isometric action RPG. Repaint the supplied silver-haired scout as exactly the SAME recognizable person: face, skin, hair, build, blue field jumpsuit, orange harness/pouches, boots and lighting. The first reference defines the scout identity and whole-body poses. The second reference if present ONLY defines the profession instrument. NO head/body collage, NO separate limbs.
EXACTLY 8 columns x 6 rows =48 fully separate complete figures, regular equal cells, landscape 4:3 sheet around1536x1152. True transparent alpha; NO floor, shadows, text, borders or stray floating fragments. A complete figure and its instrument must fit in its cell with generous margins. No glowing cloud, no particles or trails baked into this art.
Column facings, fixed in EVERY row: front/south; southeast/right-front; east/right profile; northeast/right-back; north/back; northwest/left-back; west/left profile; southwest/left-front. Raised camera matching game reference, consistent scale in all cells. Same person in all48 images.
Row1 idle ready stance.
Row2 walking left-foot contact, right leg trails.
Row3 passing: right knee passes support leg, planted left sole.
Row4 right-foot contact, left leg trails.
Row5 passing: left knee passes support leg, planted right sole.
Row6 compact profession attack/cast/command directed forward in the column facing, dominant arm extended, sensible connected shoulder-elbow-wrist-gripping fingers. No deep squat, giant leap or change in torso size.
The walk must be a natural four-phase grounded WALK, not running, high-knee hopping or duplicated contact poses. Both left/right profiles need clear alternating feet and a narrow passing stance. Feet visible and steady ground baseline, human proportions uniform through idle/walk/action. Top-left muted light, textured cloth/leather/metal, readable highlights at gameplay scale. No outlines or chibi. Preserve weapon thickness/connected grip where appropriate. All original saber/rifle/pistol weapons must be removed completely.
PROFESSION: ASTRAL MANIPULATOR. Only a compact technologically sophisticated casting GAUNTLET on the dominant right hand and forearm, with segmented dark metal wrist plates and a small blue-cyan channel/palm emitter. Natural five-finger glove; no staff, gun, saber, orb held separately or energy blade. In idle and walks the hand is relaxed forward at belt height, fingers naturally curled, not holding an invisible rifle. In action row the palm/fingers open forward, cyan focus visible at palm and wrist, other arm balances the cast. Both arms are continuous and anatomically attached. Very restrained cyan core only, no lightning/flames/energy cloud in the sprite: those are runtime effects. Keep the scout's blue/orange clothing; don't turn the scout into the other reference's dark-haired armored person.
FEMALE BATEDORA, initial blue cloth outfit and orange field harness, no helmet. Match her original silver swept-back braided hair, brown skin and female build. Do not change her face or hair between poses.
